scope_note: This bundle enumerates the owner function surface (addr/size/name/module attribution) for the win64-1.2.3 relay subsystem. No decompile() calls were made; function bodies are NOT reversed in this bundle. Decompile/call-tree/interface/DTO work is a separate follow-up leaf per command.
method: layer1: relay marker/managed-block/DTO-field string search (find_regex) -> xrefs_to (1-2 hop) -> enclosing function

layer2: panic::Location source-path string (src\core\relay\*.rs, two panic-Location pagination sweeps) -> xrefs_to(string) -> Location struct -> xrefs_to(struct) -> enclosing function (two-hop, per red line 24 / ida-dirtree-module-recovery.md §3①)
layer3: frontend ipc-contracts.jsonl relay/proxy command name string -> find_regex -> xrefs_to (1-hop) -> unique owner = command handler (per red line 24 §3③)
layer4 (opportunistic): Rust type-name string (codexmate_lib::core::relay::codex_mutation::CodexMutationGate) -> xrefs_to -> candidate owners
call_graph_propagation: not applied in this pass (string-based coverage was sufficient for all 29 confirmed-present relay submodules; strict >=2-caller propagation reserved as follow-up for any remaining truly_undone gaps)
platform_independence: All evidence produced live against the windows-x64 1.2.3 IDB via mcp__ida-pro-mcp-win__* equivalent HTTP MCP endpoint (<内网IP>:13337). No macOS evidence was used to infer Windows ownership. macOS module names (from raw/aimami/1.2.3/macos-arm64/core/relay/*) were used only as *search hints* to check for independent Windows string evidence (transition_journal / breaker / native_responses_compat / upstream_url searched, zero windows hits -> left Unknown, NOT claimed absent or present).

tier_definitions.A: command-string exact 1-hop xref, unique owner (dispatcher-level handler)
tier_definitions.B: panic-Location or type-name two-hop attributed function that already has a real (non-sub_) IDB name from a prior full-decompile session
tier_definitions.C: panic-Location or type-name two-hop attributed function still named sub_XXXX (candidate helper/internal-impl, not yet decompiled/named)
tier_definitions.BLOCKED: ambiguous single-hit landing inside an oversized function inconsistent with the per-command owner pattern seen elsewhere; suspected shared dispatcher/ICF fold, not a dedicated owner

tool: IDA MCP (mcp__ida-pro-mcp-win__* equivalent via idacall.py HTTP)
